newsitem.title: PERU: Peru says Feb oil output rises 2.19 pct vs yr ago.
newsitem.headline: Peru says Feb oil output rises 2.19 pct vs yr ago.

text.p: Peru produced an average of 120,320 barrels per day (bpd) of crude oil in February, up 2.19 percent from the same month last year, the Energy and Mines Ministry said Thursday.
Total oil production in February was 3.37 million barrels, the ministry added in its monthly report.
Output in the first two months rose 1.95 percent to 118,930 bpd, compared with January and February of 1996.

Natural gas output in February averaged 20.471 million cubic feet per day, down 15.87 percent from the same month last year. Gas output in the first two months was off 15.77 percent to 24.38 million cubic feet per day.
Total oil production in Peru dropped 2.9 percent in 1996 to an average of 118,270 bpd of crude.
U.S.-based firms Occidental Petroleum Corp, Petro- Tech S.A., Argentina's Pluspetrol and state oil company Petroperu S.A. account for more than 90 percent of Peru's total oil output.
